Binary reader adapted from yuuka-dev/anno-save-analyzer, commit04535d59f5eb246ddd79d4e87bc1176ffb8df595, MIT license (LICENSE.txt). Only standard-library RDA/FileDB primitives are included; no TUI, lxml, pandas or high-level heuristic readers. Local package initializers intentionally expose no optional XML dependencies. Companion modifications add bounded RDA decompression, record-size validation and a FileDB nesting limit.
